title: Egyptian Date Tagine Chicken
description: A Chinese-inspired dish using traditional Egyptian ingredients, featuring the sweet flavors of dates and the tender taste of chicken. This recipe is a unique fusion of flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dates and cook for 2 minutes, until caramelized.
Return the chicken to the pan and pour in the soy sauce and honey.
Simmer the mixture for 10-15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the chicken over kissed rice and garnish with additional dates if desired.
